limitations: The exact never-captured probability is proved for one excitation initially at the all-zero corner, uniform real nonzero graph hopping, and strictly positive irreversible loss at every vertex of exactly one Hamming weight. It does not give finite-time capture rates, arbitrary starting states, partial detector shells, coherent disorder or dephasing. Prior work supplies the generic dark-state principle and Krawtchouk algebra; independent historical priority remains open.
scientific_integrity: The all-dimension assertion is proved analytically. Independent full-spectral and matrix-exponential computations test finite instances only; long-time numerical agreement is not a proof. No external independent review is claimed.
title: Perfect-square survival under Hamming-sphere absorption on a quantum hypercube
